description: An agent-based, network-embedded simulation of mask-wearing adoption and compliance diffusion under social influence, information campaigns, access constraints, and policy enforcement, with locations, retailers, media, and government agents interacting daily.

modules.name: PopulationNetworkInit
modules.description: Initialize agents, households, locations, retailers, government, media, and build the social network (small-world). Assign homes, workplaces/schools, and regions.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  set RNG seed = random_seed
  create N = population_size Person agents with attributes drawn from distributions
  assign persons to regions ~ uniform over region_count
  sample households by household_size_distribution and assign persons to homes
  create locations per type proportional to population and capacity_utilization
  assign workplaces/schools to employed/students
  build social graph using Watts-Strogatz small-world with avg_social_degree
  set initial adoption_state = 1 for a Bernoulli(initial_adoption_rate)
  set initial mask_stock ~ Poisson(3)
  create retailers per region; set inventory and price
  instantiate Government and Media with specified attributes

modules.name: InformationAndBeliefUpdate
modules.description: Update perceived risk/benefit and mask attitudes from government/media messages, peer behavior, household norms, and exogenous prevalence.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  # Broadcast update (every message_frequency_days)
  if t % message_frequency_days == 0:
    info_signal = campaign_intensity * agent.government.campaign_intensity * agent.media.reliability * (1 - media_bias) * information_effect_strength
    misinfo_signal = misinformation_rate * (1 + abs(media_bias)) * (1 - agent.media.reliability)
  else:
    info_signal = 0; misinfo_signal = 0
  # Peer influence
  sample neighbors S of size neighbor_sample_size (or all if smaller)
  peer_adoption = mean(adoption_state of S)
  household_norm = mean(adoption_state of household(i))
  # Exogenous risk feedback
  risk_exo = exogenous_prevalence_constant
  # Update risk perception and benefits
  delta_risk = risk_feedback_weight * risk_exo + social_influence_strength * peer_adoption + household_norms_strength * household_norm + info_signal - misinfo_signal * susceptibility_to_misinformation * (1 - trust_in_authorities * (1 - discount_trust_on_misinformation))
  i.risk_perception = clip( (1 - learning_rate)*i.risk_perception + learning_rate*(base_risk_perception + delta_risk), 0, 1)
  i.perceived_benefit = clip(i.risk_perception * (1 + i.conformity_trait), 0, 2)
  # Share information
  with probability share_information_probability: broadcast i's adoption_state to neighbors (affects their peer_adoption next tick)
  # Update mask attitude (bounded)
  i.mask_attitude = clip( i.mask_attitude + learning_rate*(i.perceived_benefit - i.perceived_cost), -2, 2 )
notes: Media bias > 0 leans against pro-mask messaging; < 0 leans pro-mask.
Political polarization effect can be embedded by modifying susceptibility_to_misinformation or trust externally during initialization.

modules.name: DecisionCompliance
modules.description: Agents decide whether to wear masks based on updated beliefs, costs (including fatigue), access, and mandate effectiveness.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  # Cost dynamics
  fatigue = compliance_fatigue_rate * t
  mandate_boost = agent.government.policy_level * mandate_effectiveness
  i.perceived_cost = clip( (1 + fatigue) * (1 - i.mask_access) + 0.2, 0, 3)  # 0.2 baseline discomfort
  utility_mask = i.perceived_benefit + mandate_boost - i.perceived_cost
  p_wear = 1 / (1 + exp(- utility_mask / max(1e-6, decision_temperature)))
  if i.mask_stock <= 0: p_wear = p_wear * (1 - adoption_decay_without_access)
  draw u ~ Uniform(0,1); i.adoption_state = 1 if (u < p_wear) else 0
notes: Access constraints lower realized adoption even if attitudes are favorable.

modules.name: MaskSupplyAndAcquisition
modules.description: Retailers restock and price masks; government distributes/subsidizes; individuals acquire masks subject to inventory, rationing, and price.

update_rule.pseudocode:
# Retailer restocking and pricing
for each retailer r:
  if t % retailer_restock_interval_days == 0:
    r.inventory += retailer_restock_quantity
  demand_proxy = previous_day_sales / max(1, r.inventory + previous_day_sales)
  price_adj = 1 + price_markup_sensitivity * (demand_proxy - 0.5)
  r.price = max(0.1, mask_price * price_adj)

# Government distribution
free_masks = int(gov_distribution_rate * len(agents.persons))
allocate free_masks across regions proportional to population
update government cost += free_masks * (mask_price - subsidy_per_mask)  # assuming government procures at mask_price

# Individual acquisitions and stock consumption
for each person i:
  # consume masks
  daily_use = mask_use_rate_per_day / mask_reuse_factor
  if i.adoption_state == 1:
    i.mask_stock -= daily_use
  i.mask_access = 1 if i.mask_stock > 0 else 0

  # decide to acquire
  needed = max(0, ceil(7 * daily_use) - i.mask_stock)  # target 1-week buffer
  if needed > 0:
    eligible_subsidy = (i.income <= income_quantile_threshold(income_subsidy_threshold_quantile)) and (random() < subsidy_level)
    effective_price = max(0, min([r.price for r in retailers_in_region(i.region_id)]) - (subsidy_per_mask if eligible_subsidy else 0))
    willingness = price_elasticity * (i.income / (i.income + 1))
    buy_qty = min(needed, retailer_ration_limit_per_purchase) if rationing_policy_enabled else needed
    if available_inventory_in_region(i.region_id) >= buy_qty and random() < willingness:
      allocate buy_qty from retailers FIFO by inventory
      i.mask_stock += buy_qty
      record sale in flows.mask_purchases
      policy_cost += (eligible_subsidy ? subsidy_per_mask * buy_qty : 0)
notes: Retail price responds to demand via a simple markup rule.
Willingness to buy increases with income and lower prices.
Government free distribution is simple proportional allocation by region.
Mask consumption depends on daily use adjusted by reuse.

modules.name: PolicyEnforcementAndAdmission
modules.description: Locations check entry and enforce mask rules; fines applied; compliance observed by location type.

notes: Admission rules deter entry without a mask, reinforcing adoption through access.

modules.name: MobilityAndLocationUse
modules.description: Generate daily visits for persons to non-home locations conditional on attendance rates and capacity utilization.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  visits = {}
  if has_workplace(i) and random() < workplace_attendance_rate: visits['workplace'] += 1
  if is_student(i) and random() < school_attendance_rate: visits['school'] += 1
  if random() < transit_usage_rate: visits['transit'] += 1
  if random() < retail_visit_rate: visits['retail'] += 1
  if random() < public_space_visit_rate: visits['public_space'] += 1
  assign i to specific locations by type respecting capacity utilization
notes: Capacity constraints throttle visit flows when exceeded.
Foot traffic rates at locations can modulate sampling.

modules.name: GovernmentPolicy
modules.description: Adjust policy level and mandate timing over time based on adoption outcomes or schedule.

notes: Simple feedback controller on adoption rate.
Policy level 0..3 scales mandate strictness and campaign intensity (used indirectly).

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregate observables and compute inequality and policy cost accounting.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate = mean(i.adoption_state for i in persons)
compliance_by_type = {type: mean(adoption among visitors of that type)}
policy_cost = subsidy_outlays + distribution_costs - fines_collected
supply_outage_daily = 1 if any(retailer.inventory == 0) else 0
mask_purchase_rate_daily = total_masks_sold / len(persons)
# Gini across income quintiles
group_means = mean(adoption_state by income quintile)
gini = Gini(group_means weighted by group size)
# Misinformation impact via counterfactual weight stripping misinfo terms
misinfo_free_adoption = recompute adoption probability p_wear with misinfo_signal = 0 (no state change) and average p_wear
misinformation_impact = misinfo_free_adoption - adoption_rate
notes: Gini computed over group means approximates inequality in adoption.
Misinformation impact is an on-the-fly counterfactual using current beliefs minus misinfo terms.

algorithms.WattsStrogatzSmallWorld: Generate a small-world social network with N nodes, mean degree k, rewiring prob p=0.1.
algorithms.BeliefUpdateLogit: Weighted linear update to risk/benefit followed by clipping; adoption probability via logistic with temperature.
algorithms.InventoryRestock_sS: Retailers restock to inventory + Q every T days, price adjusts using demand proxy.
algorithms.LocationAdmissionEnforcement: Stochastic admission checks and fine issuance at locations with mask-required policies.
algorithms.GiniCoefficient: Compute Gini on group means by income quintiles with group-size weights.
algorithms.CounterfactualMisinformation: Recompute per-agent p_wear with misinformation terms removed to estimate marginal impact.
